name: Ookayama
tagline: Shinagawa in 22 minutes and Shibuya in 23 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, where Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 31 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 22 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 31.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 14.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 31.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 21.8 m to 36.4 m, a difference of 14.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 12 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東急病院, about 1 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 中原病院, about 4 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Meguro Line and Tokyu Oimachi Line. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyu Meguro Line runs at 133% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 不動前→目黒, which this station is not on. Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118%. Its busiest stretch is 九品仏→自由が丘, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. What pushes the figure up: a small projected flood depth and schools and parks within walking distance. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Midorigaoka is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Ookayama is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ookayama. Midorigaoka has only the Tokyu Oimachi Line, so Ookayama is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Midorigaoka takes 6 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥6,000 more at Midorigaoka.

neighbours.lead: Kita-Senzoku is ahead on quiet, but Ookayama is ahead on the number of lines.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ookayama. Kita-Senzoku has only the Tokyu Oimachi Line, so Ookayama is the better connected. To Otemachi, for instance, Kita-Senzoku takes 5 minutes longer. On quiet, though, Kita-Senzoku comes out ahead.

noiseSources: The nearest big road, 環七通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
